credit.title: Spiromorphs
credit.description: Spiromorphs are procedural roulette figures that investigate aesthetic relationships between form, symmetry and rotary motion. Variations are plotted using chained circles that overlay periodic continuous curves on an empty universe. The dynamic engine generates emergent morphologies of different colors and types while producing irregular yet harmonic forms. Charity: 5% of sales will be donated to National Alzheimer’s Foundation, a nonprofit organization helping families who suffer from neurological diseases.

listing.lineage: A remix of Spiromorphs by SAB, on Art Blocks. The artist's own code runs, untouched; the controls hook the lines where it chooses each trait, and with none set it paints exactly what the original paints.
